name: Critical Malware Detected
description: Endpoint protection reported a malware or ransomware detection.

name: Repeated Login Failures
description: High-severity authentication failures indicate a brute-force attempt.

name: Privilege Escalation Attempt
description: A privilege escalation or unauthorized elevation attempt was observed.

name: Network Reconnaissance Activity
description: Port scans or network reconnaissance patterns from a host.

name: Data Exfiltration Attempt
description: Suspected exfiltration of data from the environment.

name: Suspicious Activity on Sensitive Asset
description: Any critical event regardless of type requires immediate attention.

name: Command Shell or Payload Activity
description: Command-and-control or payload delivery indicators observed.
